sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek: Nemesis
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Captain Picard and his crew are sent to the planet Romulus, where a new leader, Shinzon, wishes to make peace with the Federation. Upon arriving at the planet, Picard discovers Shinzon's plan is to destroy the Enterprise with his powerful craft the Scimitar and then advance on a defenceless Earth. Picard must use all his cunning to outwit his adversary but faces an obstacle: Shizon is a younger clone of himself.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Pacific Rim
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A washed-up ex-pilot and an untested trainee must drive an old, obsolete robot in a last-ditch effort to repel a lethal force of monstrous invaders.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: When the Federation receives a distress signal from planet Vulcan during a hearing to decide whether Kirk has cheated on his final test at the academy, his friend Dr McCoy sneaks him aboard the USS Enterprise as it sets out on its maiden voyage.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The crew of the Starship Enterprise returns home after an act of terrorism within its own organization destroys most of Starfleet. With a personal score to settle, Capt. James T. Kirk leads a mission to capture a one-man weapon of mass destruction.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Crazies
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: David Dutton is the sheriff of picture-perfect American town Ogden Marsh. One night and out of the blue one of its citizens shows up during a baseball game with a shot-gun and ready to kill. This is the beginning of a spiral of violence and mayhem.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Bugonia
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Two conspiracy-obsessed men kidnap the CEO of a major company when they become convinced that she's an alien who wants to destroy Earth.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: They Will Kill You
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A woman answers a cryptic ad for a housekeeping job at a luxurious yet foreboding New York City high-rise. Upon arrival, she discovers residents have vanished without a trace for decades, fuelling whispers of a satanic cult lurking in the shadows.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A kidnapped family and their two murderous captors confront bloodthirsty demons after crossing the Mexican border.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Exorcist
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A famous actress calls upon medical science for help when her daughter begins behaving strangely, but without any success. Then, as bizarre and horrific incidents involving the daughter increase, her mother turns in desperation to the Church, and to a priest who doubts his own faith.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Towering Inferno
sky cinema thriller.desc: At the opening party of a colossal, but poorly constructed office building, a massive fire breaks out that threatens to destroy the tower and everyone in it.

sky cinema thriller.title: Clear and Present Danger
sky cinema thriller.desc: Investigating the assassination of a friend of the President, CIA agent Ryan discovers that his friend was in league with the Colombian drugs cartels. In revenge, a paramilitary force is sent in to wipe out the drug lords but when the operation goes wrong, they're abandoned by their country. Now their only hope is Ryan and fellow renegade operative Clark.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Bank Job
sky cinema thriller.desc: London, 1971: Terry Leather's ex-girlfriend Martine turns up with a tempting proposition. A bank's alarm is scheduled to be turned off for a week, so Terry and his team tunnel through to the vault from a neighbouring property.

sky cinema thriller.title: Revolver
sky cinema thriller.desc: Jake Green is a hotshot gambler, long on audacity and short on common sense. Jake served seven years in jail for a crime he didn't commit after taking the rap for mean crime boss Dorothy Macha. Upon his release he takes on Macha in a private casino game, causes humiliation, and wins. While Macha puts out an order on Jake's life, Jake meets brothers Avi and Zach who protect him and plot to take Macha down.

sky cinema thriller.title: Jaws 2
sky cinema thriller.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

sky cinema thriller.title: Jaws III
sky cinema thriller.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

sky cinema thriller.title: Hungry
sky cinema thriller.desc: After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose.

sky cinema thriller.title: Safe House
sky cinema thriller.desc: Six government agents become trapped inside a high-security safe house after a terrorist attack in downtown Los Angeles. They soon realise they must survive not just the enemy outside, but the potential traitor among them.

sky cinema thriller.title: Snatch
sky cinema thriller.desc: Based on three hybridising narrative strands, three groups of villains are intent on retrieving a missing diamond. Turkish and Tommy team up with a pugilistic Irish gypsy named Mickey for the purpose of rigging unlicensed boxing matches. However, their opponent also arranges some dodgy betting with the courier of the stolen diamond, who subsequently goes missing. To complicate further, a New York gangster arrives on the scene.

sky cinema thriller.title: Black Bag
sky cinema thriller.desc: When his beloved wife, Kathryn, is suspected of betraying the nation, intelligence agent George Woodhouse faces the ultimate test -- loyalty to his marriage or his country.

sky cinema thriller.title: Along Came a Spider
sky cinema thriller.desc: A detective and a Secret Service agent investigate the abduction of a senator's daughter from a school.

sky cinema greats.title: Smokey and the Bandit
sky cinema greats.desc: Tongue-in-cheek tale about a high-speed car chase across America involving a sheriff and a bootlegger with crash stunts galore. All goes well for the Bandit as he drives from Texas to Georgia with a truckload of illicit beer until he stops to pick up a damsel in distress, who also happens to be the sheriff's daughter.

sky cinema greats.title: Police Academy
sky cinema greats.desc: Misfits realise their dreams of becoming cops when a mayoral decree forces the police academy to open its doors to all.

sky cinema greats.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
sky cinema greats.desc: Mahoney and friends have graduated from the Police Academy and are issued with their first assignments. As before, their cheerfulness and devotion to duty outweighs any shortcomings, but are they ready to do battle with a band of graffiti daubing terrorists?

sky cinema greats.title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
sky cinema greats.desc: Slapstick farce with the incompetent cops as they set about saving their beloved academy from closure. Cutbacks mean that only one of the two police training schools can stay open, so Commandant Lassard appeals to the motley crew of graduates to come and train new recruits. However, the rival academy intends to sabotage their plans by cutting their training time down to a minimum.

sky cinema greats.title: Uncle Buck
sky cinema greats.desc: A bungling bachelor becomes a last-minute babysitter. Buck's brother's three children are foisted on him when the parents are called away from home indefinitely. Although he seems to be an unsuitable guardian, Buck turns out to have an unexpected knack for parenting, but he must work hard to prove himself, especially when he needs to save his eldest niece from her unsavoury boyfriend.

sky cinema greats.title: Boomerang
sky cinema greats.desc: A womanising New York marketing man meets his match in his new boss. After initially spurning his advances, she ultimately gives him a taste of his own medicine.

sky cinema greats.title: Smokey and the Bandit
sky cinema greats.desc: Tongue-in-cheek tale about a high-speed car chase across America involving a sheriff and a bootlegger with crash stunts galore. All goes well for the Bandit as he drives from Texas to Georgia with a truckload of illicit beer until he stops to pick up a damsel in distress, who also happens to be the sheriff's daughter.

sky cinema greats.title: Liar Liar
sky cinema greats.desc: A slick attorney fails to show up for his son's fifth birthday, prompting the boy to make a wish that his father would tell the truth for just one day. Miraculously, the wish is granted and for the next 24 hours, the formerly mendacious lawyer is unable to tell a single lie.

sky cinema greats.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
sky cinema greats.desc: Tale about an unconventional sleuth's attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.

sky cinema greats.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
sky cinema greats.desc: Sequel about the zany private detective who specialises in locating missing pets. Ace Ventura travels to Africa to search for a kidnapped sacred albino bat, which reputedly has the power to restore peace between two warring tribes.

sky cinema greats.title: Peggy Sue Got Married
sky cinema greats.desc: A bittersweet story about a 43-year-old woman on the verge of divorce who magically travels back in time to her senior high-school years. She is able to act with the benefit of hindsight, but despite her efforts, she falls for the same boy all over again.

sky cinema greats.title: Footloose
sky cinema greats.desc: Chicago teen Ren and his family move to the small midwestern town of Bomont, where rock music has been banned.

sky cinema greats.title: Chaplin
sky cinema greats.desc: Re-creation of the life of comic genius Charlie Chaplin, from his humble beginnings in south London through his early days in British vaudeville, his silent movie career in America and his late masterpieces. His turbulent personal life saw four marriages and an enforced exile from the US - though he returned to receive an honorary Oscar in 1972.

sky cinema drama.title: Quartet
sky cinema drama.desc: A long-smouldering flame is rekindled when a once-popular opera star reunites with her ex-husband and fellow performers at a retirement home for musicians.

sky cinema drama.title: Widow Clicquot
sky cinema drama.desc: The story behind the Veuve Clicquot champagne family and business that began in the late 18th century.

sky cinema drama.title: True Grit
sky cinema drama.desc: John Wayne won an Oscar here as Rooster Cogburn, a lawman recruited by a teenager seeking revenge on her father's murderer.

sky cinema drama.title: Birdy
sky cinema drama.desc: A soldier returns from Vietnam to find his boyhood friend, also a fellow soldier, in a military hospital, having suffered a mental breakdown in which he has become detached from reality and imagines that he is a bird.

sky cinema drama.title: Cool Hand Luke
sky cinema drama.desc: A gutsy prisoner earns the admiration of inmates and the wrath of guards by constant defiance and bids for freedom.

sky cinema drama.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
sky cinema drama.desc: Singer Freddie Mercury defies stereotypes and convention to become one of history's most beloved entertainers. After leaving Queen to pursue a solo career, Mercury reunites with the band for one of the greatest performances in rock 'n' roll history.

sky cinema drama.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
sky cinema drama.desc: A single father and his young son endure many hardships as the father struggles to provide a better future for both of them.

sky cinema drama.title: Hamnet
sky cinema drama.desc: William Shakespeare and his wife, Agnes, celebrate the birth of their son, Hamnet. However, when tragedy strikes and Hamnet dies at a young age, it inspires Shakespeare to write his timeless masterpiece `Hamlet'.

sky cinema drama.title: Cookster: The Darkest Days
sky cinema drama.desc: A dyslexic teen misunderstood by his family and desperate for respect, becomes a drug dealer struggling with addiction and debt while a rival threatens to destroy his world, driving him apart from the woman he loves.
